L1_AGE.description: Days since the perpetual contract was listed

L1_OI_MCAP.description: Perp open-interest notional divided by circulating market cap

L1_PERP_SPOT.description: Perp 24h volume divided by same-venue spot 24h volume

L1_UNLOCK.description: Team/investor unlock above 5% of circulating within 30 days
